hub_dia = 53.3
hub_thk = 10.2
flange_dia = 81.7
flange_thk = 15.3
bore_dia = 15.6
hex_flat = 15.0
hex_depth = 6.0

hub = Pos(0, 0, hub_thk/2) * Cylinder(hub_dia/2, hub_thk)
flange = Pos(0, 0, hub_thk + flange_thk/2) * Cylinder(flange_dia/2, flange_thk)
solid_body = hub + flange

total_h = hub_thk + flange_thk
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, total_h/2) * Cylinder(bore_dia/2, total_h + 1)

with BuildPart() as hp:
    with BuildSketch() as hs:
        RegularPolygon(hex_flat, 6)
    extrude(amount=hex_depth)
hex_solid = Pos(0, 0, total_h - hex_depth) * hp.part
solid_body = solid_body - hex_solid

part = solid_body
part.name = "hub_with_flange"
export_step(part, "output.step")
